## GET `/oauth2_pub_priv_key_pair`

**Tier:** T0  

Returns a public and private key pair, This is not part of the FlashArray API, it's a helper endpoint making it easier to generate an oauth2 token_id in this Swagger UI. They keys are generated in the Docker container running on this machine. Recommend to NOT use this API but to use OpenSSL instead for production use cases: You can generate a public and private RSA key pair like this: openssl genrsa -des3 -out private.pem 2048 That generates a 2048-bit RSA key pair, encrypts them with a password you provide and writes them to a file. You need to next extract the public key file. You will use…

**Responses:** `200` Token Generated body fields: `private_key`, `public_key`

## POST `/oauth2_token_from_private_key`

**Tier:** auth  

Authenticates to Flasharray, This returns a token_id (think session id), from an existing API Client, This is not part of the FlashArray API, it's a helper endpoint making it easy to generate an oauth2 token_id in this Swagger UI. The private key is being passed into the Docker container in order to sign the JWT token. Take a look at the Docker container output to see more details of what is happening. Copy the output value, Authorization header, and then click on the green Authorize button at the top of the page. Paste in the value into

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `issuer_name` | header | string |  | Issuer value displayed in the FlashArray API Registration page or pureapiclient list ) by default it's the same name as API Client |
| `client_id` | header | string |  | Client Id value displayed in the FlashArray API Registration page or pureapiclient list |
| `key_id` | header | string |  | Key Id value displayed in the FlashArray API Registration page or pureapiclient list |
| `username` | header | string |  | The name of a valid user on the FlashArray that will be authenticated to. |

**Request body** (required): `inline`

**Responses:** `200` Token Generated body fields: `Authorization`, `description`
